title: 第629章 别过来第628章 楚家什么情况
slug: 满级雷灵根卷哭修仙界
lines: 他站在一片枯死的灵田中央，脚下的地面已经完全龟裂了，裂缝里透出的暗红色光像血管一样在地表蔓延。
他歪着头看玄城子，脖子以一个不太自然的角度拧着，像一个还在适应自己新骨骼的人在试探脖颈的极限活动范围：
“玄掌门……你也来拦我？”
他的声音比刚才更奇怪了，像是在砂纸上磨过一遍之后又塞进喉咙里重新挤出来的。
正常人说话是一个声调，他说话是两股声音叠在一起，一层是楚云澜原本的嗓音，另一层更低更粗，像有什么东西正趴在他声带后面跟着他一起发声，偶尔还超过他半拍。
玄城子拔出剑来，剑光在昏暗的天色下亮了一下又稳住：
“楚云澜，你被禁术反噬了。停下来，我们可以帮你稳住。你体内的龙族力量不是你能控制的，它在吞噬你。你越动用它，它就吞得越快。”
“吞噬？”
楚云澜重复了一遍这个词，然后笑了一声。那笑声不成调，像是有人用指甲在黑板上刮了半下又停住了：“你们懂什么？”
他的声音猛地拔高了，又在高处裂开，碎成好几个音阶，像是在同时说三句不同的话：
“你们有手有脚，有灵脉有修为……你们站在那儿说话不腰疼，你们懂什么？我的命是拿来换的，我的胳膊是拿去给人砍的，我的气运是拿来填坑的。你们什么都没少过，你们凭什么跟我说‘帮你稳住’？你们站得那么稳，当然不急。”
他说话的时候，周围的灵力开始翻涌，像一锅被烧开的水。
刘长老第一个动了。
火掌从侧面拍出去，灵力带起一道灼热的气浪，直取楚云澜的右肩。
周长老紧随其后，寒气在半空中凝成一道冰刃，切断了楚云澜的退路。
两人的攻击配合得默契又精准。
楚云澜没有躲。
他抬起那只暗红色的龙爪，动作不快不慢，甚至带着一种“我就在这儿等你”的从容。
爪尖划过空气的时候，刘长老的火掌在距离他肩头不到一尺的地方被硬生生拍散，火光四溅，落在地上烧焦了一片枯草。
周长老的冰刃撞在龙爪的侧面，碎成了无数细小的冰晶，像碎玻璃一样散了一地，落到地面上时又碎得更细了。
玄城子的剑光从正面压下来，剑尖抵在楚云澜胸口的时候顿了一下。
他感觉到一股巨大的反震力顺着剑身传回自己的手臂，像劈在一块厚实的铁板上，震得他手腕发麻。
他退了半步，靴底在干裂的泥地上犁出一道深痕，剑尖微微颤着，带出一丝细碎的嗡鸣。
刘长老捂着被震伤的手腕退了两步，火灵力在经脉里乱窜了一阵才被压下来：
“他现在的肉身强度至少是化神中期以上！这已经不是禁术能解释的了！他体内有什么东西在替他撑着！”
玄城子握紧剑柄，灵力重新灌入剑身：“这不是他自己的力量，是禁术在烧他的命。撑不了多久的。”
楚云澜低吼了一声，那道声音比刚才更低更沉，像一根粗弦被用力拨了一下后还在震颤。
暗金色的竖瞳在昏暗的天光下转了一圈，从玄城子身上移到刘长老身上，又从刘长老身上移到周长老身上。
他抬头看了一眼天空，那个动作很慢，像是在确认什么东西，又像是单纯在感受风吹过鳞片边缘的感觉。
然后他低下头，目光落向某个方向，眼珠没怎么动，但瞳孔微微缩了一下，像是感应到了什么。
他的嘴角扯了一下，那个弧度介于冷笑和肌肉痉挛之间：“来吧，都来吧。正好一起算。”
那个方向的钱多多一哆嗦，缩了缩脖子：“他刚刚是不是看我了？”
“我总觉得他的视线从我脸上扫过去了……”钱多多往林枝意身后躲了躲。
东州边境的枯灵田里，玄城子和两位长老正被楚云澜一爪掀翻在地，刘长老捂着右臂退了三步，灵力在经脉里横冲直撞，像有人在血管里塞了一把炮仗，炸得他半边身子发麻。
玄城子撑剑站稳，嘴角已经渗出一丝血迹，剑身上的光芒暗了又亮，亮了又暗，像一盏被风吹得忽明忽灭的灯。
楚云澜站在裂开的田地中央，暗金色的竖瞳扫过地上那三个还在喘气的人影，喉咙里发出一声含混的嘶响，那声音像是从胸腔最深处挤出来的，带着一种不属于人类声带的震颤，像有另外一个人在替他发声。
他转身，没再回头。
脚下的地面随着他的每一步裂开更深的缝，暗红色的光从裂缝里涌出来，沿着他走过的路径一路蔓延，像是一条正在苏醒的血管网络。
玄城子撑着剑站起来，看着那个背影消失在远处翻涌的烟尘里。
他抬手擦了一下嘴角的血，手掌在法袍上蹭了蹭，低头看了一眼掌心那道被龙爪刮出的口子：
“……他体内的东西不是他在控制，是那东西在往东边牵引他。”
刘长老从地上爬起来，左手还按着右臂，脸色难看得很：
content_en:
He stood in the middle of a dead spiritual field. The ground under his feet was completely cracked, and the dark red light from the cracks spread like blood vessels on the surface.
He tilted his head and looked at Xuanchengzi, his neck twisted at an unnatural angle, like a man who was still adapting to his new bones testing the extreme range of movement of his neck:
"Master Xuan...are you coming to stop me too?"
His voice was even stranger than before, as if it had been rubbed with sandpaper and then stuffed into his throat and squeezed out again.
Normal people speak in the same tone. When he spoke, he had two voices superimposed on top of each other. One was Chu Yunlan's original voice, and the other was lower and thicker. It was like something was lying behind his vocal cords to follow him and occasionally beat him by half a beat.
Xuanchengzi drew out his sword, and the sword's light shone brightly under the dim sky and then stabilized:
"Chu Yunlan, you have been bitten by the forbidden technique. Stop and we can help you stabilize. The dragon power in your body is beyond your control, it is swallowing you up. The more you use it, the faster it will swallow you up."
"Swallow?"
Chu Yunlan repeated the word and then laughed. The laughter was out of tune, as if someone scratched the blackboard with their fingernails and then stopped: "What do you know?"
His voice suddenly rose in pitch, then cracked at a higher level, breaking into several scales, as if he was saying three different words at the same time:
"You have hands and feet, spiritual veins and cultivation... You are standing there talking without back pain, what do you know? My life was exchanged, my arms were chopped off, and my luck was used to fill holes. You haven't missed anything. Why do you say to me, 'Help you hold on steady'? You stand so steadily, of course you are not in a hurry."
As he spoke, the spiritual energy around him began to surge, like a pot of boiling water.
Elder Liu was the first to move.
The fire palm shot out from the side, and the spiritual power brought up a searing wave of air that went straight to Chu Yunlan's right shoulder.
Elder Zhou followed closely behind, and the cold air condensed into an ice blade in mid-air, cutting off Chu Yunlan's retreat.
The two attacks were coordinated and precise.
Chu Yunlan did not hide.
He raised the dark red dragon claw, his movements neither fast nor slow, even with a calmness that said, "I'll be right here waiting for you."
When the tip of his claws sliced ​​through the air, Elder Liu's fire palm was forcefully blown away less than a foot away from his shoulder. The fire scattered and fell to the ground, scorching a piece of withered grass.
Elder Zhou's ice blade hit the side of the dragon's claw and shattered into countless tiny ice crystals, scattering like broken glass and breaking even finer when it fell to the ground.
Xuanchengzi's sword light came down from the front, and he paused when the tip of the sword touched Chu Yunlan's chest.
He felt a huge repulsive force transmitted back to his arm along the sword blade, like it was struck on a thick iron plate, making his wrist numb.
He took half a step back, and the soles of his boots plowed a deep mark on the cracked mud. The tip of the sword trembled slightly, making a faint hum.
Elder Liu held his injured wrist and took two steps back. The fire spirit energy rushed around in his meridians for a while before being suppressed:
"His current physical strength is at least in the middle stage of divine transformation! This cannot be explained by forbidden techniques! There is something in his body that is supporting him!"
Xuanchengzi clenched the hilt of the sword and poured spiritual power into the sword again: "This is not his own power, it is the forbidden technique that is burning his life. He won't last long."
Chu Yunlan roared, and the sound was lower and deeper than before, like a thick string that was still vibrating after being plucked hard.
The dark golden vertical pupils turned in a circle under the dim skylight, moving from Xuanchengzi to Elder Liu, and then from Elder Liu to Elder Zhou.
He raised his head and glanced at the sky. The movement was very slow, as if he was confirming something, or simply feeling the wind blowing along the edges of his scales.
Then he lowered his head and looked in a certain direction. His eyes didn't move much, but his pupils shrank slightly, as if he sensed something.
The corner of his mouth twitched, and the arc was somewhere between a sneer and a muscle spasm: "Come on, come on. Let's just count them all together."
Qian Duoduo in that direction shivered and shrank his neck: "Did he look at me just now?"
"I always feel like his eyes swept away from my face..." Qian Duoduo hid behind Lin Zhiyi.
In the Ku Ling Tian on the border of Dongzhou, Xuanchengzi and two elders were knocked to the ground by Chu Yunlan's claws. Elder Liu covered his right arm and took three steps back. Spiritual energy rushed through his meridians, as if someone had stuffed a firecracker into his blood vessels, causing half of his body to go numb.
Xuanchengzi stood firm with his sword in hand, a trace of blood seeping from the corner of his mouth. The light on the sword dimmed and brightened, brightened and dimmed again, like a lamp that was blown on and off by the wind.
Chu Yunlan stood in the middle of the cracked field, his dark golden vertical pupils scanning the three breathing figures on the ground, and he let out a vague hiss in his throat. The sound seemed to be squeezed out from the deepest part of his chest, with a tremor that did not belong to human vocal cords, as if another person was speaking for him.
He turned around and didn't look back.
The ground beneath his feet opened deeper cracks with every step he took, and dark red light poured out from the cracks, spreading along the path he took, like a network of blood vessels that was awakening.
Xuan Chengzi stood up with his sword in hand and watched the figure disappear into the billowing smoke in the distance.
He raised his hand to wipe the blood from the corner of his mouth, rubbed his palm on the robe, and looked down at the hole in his palm scratched by the dragon's claw:
"... He is not controlling the thing in his body, it is the thing that is pulling him eastward."
Elder Liu got up from the ground, his left hand still pressing his right arm, his face looking very ugly:
